title: buglossoides arvensis var. coerulescens
intro: Buglossoides arvensis var. coerulescens, commonly known as Blue Bugloss, is a flowering plant that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Buglossoides arvensis var. coerulescens include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory symptoms, such as coughing and congestion, while also exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
